notes.title: Full Game RELEASE!
notes.content:
The full version of the game has now finished all reviews and has been published! 
All eight levels have been available now, and the demo version will stop running in the near future.

If you have any questions, comments and suggestions, please discuss them freely. If you find any bugs in the game, please publish them freely. I will deal with them quickly. Thank you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39829800/d9e40fc3f924571dbcd595fb3d644b21b8065f4d.png[/img]

notes.title: Noob Operation Mode, Easy to FLY!
notes.content:
Because some players said that it was a little difficult to control, we specially made a noob operation mode, so that both novice players who just came into contact with this kind of flight shooting game and experienced wingmen can have a quick start. 
Both demo version and full version have been updated this mode, have a try!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: DEMO is now AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Our NFAD is still in the review queue. It'll be out soon. The good news is that the demo version has passed all the reviews and can be released to all of you now.

This demo version contains the first level of the full version of the game, welcome to have a try.

If you have any suggestions and opinions, or have any questions, please feel free to discuss them.
